name: example-project
notes: Copy this next to the documents it serves — never into the skill. One profile per project. Keys are optional; supply what the domain has. Paths are relative to `root`, or to this file if `root` is absent, and may be globs.

1_definition_of_record.settles: outputs, fees, SLA, audience, channels, attachments, owning unit

2_executing_artefact.settles: stages, roles, action keys, timers, notifications, terminal states

3_enforced_behaviour.settles: mandatory-field error codes, allowed values, message wording verbatim

4_live_surface.note: the running application at a pinned build — see live_ui below

5_corroborating.settles: prior revisions, UAT tickets, harvested UI glossary. Corroborating only

live_ui._comment: The scanner prints base_url and the credentials *location*. It never opens either. Nothing reads a secret.
